notes: Integration baseline 2026-11-11: phase 6 deleted trader/core/application/oms.py and trader/services/oms_callback.py; their per-file floors were removed with the modules, not lowered. No remaining floor was reduced.
Floors are two points below the measured 2026-11-04 baseline so ordinary refactoring noise does not fail the gate, while a real regression does.
A floor is a regression guard, not a quality claim. Modules below 60% are recorded explicitly and are not presented as covered.
Migrations are exercised by the PostgreSQL job; this offline-only baseline intentionally does not include those lines.
